description: This file defines a class EmployeeEducationSearchFilterParams that extends a base FilterParams class, used to encapsulate search filter parameters specifically for employee education data within the OrangeHRM system. It includes allowed sort fields and manages an employee number property.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for specifying filtering and sorting options when searching employee education records.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters object and sets default sort field to 'e.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the filter, if set.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number used as a filter criterion.
